_note: Entry/TAEM/approach reference schedules for the root flight-director laws (src/systems/guidance.ts). Orbiter-like shapes; every number [estimated] unless it cites a sourced anchor. These are command targets for effector laws, not a transcription of the onboard guidance software.

alpha_schedule._note: [estimated] commanded angle of attack vs Earth-relative speed: ~40 deg through hypersonic flight, easing to final-approach alpha subsonic. Shape follows the published orbiter entry profile (high-alpha hypersonic, low-alpha subsonic).

approach._note: [estimated] terminal-area outer loop: altitude error is measured against a linear energy line h_ref(v) = slope * (v - v_td). At the deck's approach start (~148 m/s, ~1980 m) this reads slightly high, which is the intended correction direction. Outer gamma -12 deg suits the orbiter L/D~4-5; guidance flares to -2 deg below 300 m.

bank._note: [estimated] bank law limits. Crew bank command (guid.bank_deg) remains the target in entry; TAEM/approach default wings-level unless the crew banks.

brakes._note: [estimated] brake and nose-wheel steering model. mu_brake is the friction coefficient increment at full brake command on a dry runway; steer_rate is the heading rate at full steering input.
